tasks.short: Build the monthly HR pack and ad-hoc reports on headcount, verzuim, hiring and flex hours for MT and site managers.

today.trigger: Month close, MT meeting dates, and ad-hoc requests from the HR Director, site managers or Finance by mail or Teams.
steps: Pull the nightly AFAS extract, Recruitee and agency portal exports
Reconcile headcount and FTE with payroll and the flex invoices
Refresh the Power BI pages and export to Excel or PowerPoint
Write the commentary per site and mail the pack
drudgery: Re-exporting the same agency hours every month
Writing the same 'verzuim rose in Venlo' sentences
today.time_sinks: Reconciling three agency exports with AFAS cost centres and rewriting commentary for each audience.

lenses.faster: A scheduled pipeline loads AFAS, Recruitee and agency data into one model; the pack builds itself and the analyst only checks the variance notes.
lenses.autonomous: Month close in AFAS triggers the refresh, data checks and a drafted narrative per site, sent to the analyst for release.
lenses.ambitious: Every site and team lead gets their own short monthly pack on the North Star inputs (time to hire, 90-day retention, verzuim) instead of one MT deck.
lenses.joy: No more slide pasting; the analyst spends the time explaining why Tilburg's 90-day retention dropped.
lenses.options: Draft the narrative three ways: for MT, for site managers, and for the works council with only aggregated figures.
lenses.altitude: The analyst owns metric definitions and the release checks, not the production of the pack.
reach: FP&A Analyst: flex labour cost per site in the same model
HR Business Partner: site-level talking points for manager meetings

tasks.human_edge: Knowing which numbers are politically sensitive (a reorganisation in Rotterdam, a CAO round) and what MT actually needs to decide.
tasks.pattern_why: Sources, metrics and layout are fixed and checkable; only the commentary needs a model step on top.

in_practice.trigger: AFAS payroll period closed plus nightly extract complete.
steps: Load AFAS, Recruitee and agency hours into the Power BI semantic model
Run reconciliation checks (headcount vs payroll, flex hours vs invoices)
LLM drafts variance commentary from the numbers only
Analyst reviews exceptions and releases via Power BI subscription
in_practice.human_gate: Analyst releases the pack after reviewing failed checks and the commentary.
data_needed: AFAS employee, contract and absence tables
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint HR analytics library with run log and check results

evidence.claim: Copilot in Power BI summarises reports on a prepared semantic model on Fabric F2+ or Premium capacity
evidence.source: Microsoft Learn, Copilot in Power BI [S5]

evidence.claim: Without a prepared model Copilot can misinterpret data; non-English chat not officially supported
Scheduled refresh plus subscription removes most manual production

risks: Commentary states causes the data does not support
Agency exports change format and break loads silently
Dutch-language narrative quality not supported by Copilot
research_questions: Does Noordhaven have Fabric F2+ or Premium capacity, and at what cost?
Can all three agency portals deliver hours by API or a stable file export?
How many hours per month go to reconciliation versus writing today?

tasks.short: Get the right HR figures to the right managers on time and answer their 'can you quickly pull' questions.

today.trigger: Manager or HRBP asks in Teams or mail; access requests; scheduled distribution dates.
steps: Receive the question and clarify what is meant
Check access rights for that manager's site or team
Query the model or Excel and send the answer
Maintain distribution lists and report access
drudgery: Answering the same headcount and verzuim questions every week
Manually updating access when managers change
today.time_sinks: Clarifying vague questions and checking that a manager may see the data.

lenses.faster: A read-only assistant in Teams answers common questions from verified answers on the semantic model; the analyst sees only the misses.
lenses.autonomous: A manager change in AFAS updates row-level security and subscriptions automatically.
lenses.ambitious: Every shift leader can ask about their own team's verzuim rate and open vacancies without waiting a day.
lenses.joy: Fewer interruptions; the analyst works on the questions nobody has asked before.
lenses.options: For an unclear question, offer two or three interpretations with the metric definition before answering.
lenses.altitude: The analyst curates verified answers, access rules and the minimum group size instead of answering one by one.
reach: HR Administrator: routine headcount and contract-end questions
HR Business Partner: first-line data questions from managers

tasks.human_edge: Judging when a question is really about one person, which needs an HRBP not a dashboard.
tasks.pattern_why: Several steps (interpret, check access, query, answer) with exceptions; unanswered or sensitive questions go to the analyst.

in_practice.trigger: Manager asks a question in Teams; or AFAS records a manager change.
steps: Agent states it is AI and maps the question to a verified metric
Query the semantic model under the manager's row-level security
Suppress answers on groups below the minimum size (e.g. 5)
Send answer with the definition; route misses to the analyst queue
in_practice.human_gate: Analyst reviews unmatched or sensitive questions before any answer; new verified answers need analyst approval.
in_practice.logs_to: Question and answer log in SharePoint, reviewed monthly

evidence.claim: Microsoft Workforce Insights agent gives managers staffing and hiring answers; warns faster access does not by itself lead to better decisions
Visier Vee answers people questions in Teams or Slack
Chatbots must disclose they are AI

risks: Works council consent needed as the tool can show performance or presence (WOR 27(1)(l))
Wrong metric chosen for an ambiguous question
research_questions: What share of manager questions in the last quarter match ten standard metrics?
Will the OR consent to a manager-facing chat on HR data with a group-size floor?
Does Copilot answer acceptably when managers ask in Dutch?

tasks.short: Keep the Power BI model, DAX measures and AFAS extract working when systems, CAO or org structure change.

today.trigger: AFAS field or cost-centre change, new site or department, CAO change, broken refresh.
steps: Diagnose what changed in the source
Edit Power Query, DAX measures and relationships
Test against last month's figures
Update documentation and notify users
drudgery: Keeping documentation in step with the model
today.time_sinks: Finding the cause of a broken refresh and regression-testing measures by hand.

lenses.faster: An AI coding assistant writes and explains DAX and Power Query changes; automated tests compare figures before and after.
lenses.autonomous: Refresh failures and schema changes in the AFAS extract raise a ticket with a suggested fix.
lenses.ambitious: A documented, tested metric layer with version control, which Noordhaven has never had.
lenses.joy: Less syntax fiddling, more time on model design.
lenses.options: Generate two or three ways to model a change (e.g. flex workers in headcount or separate) with the trade-offs.
lenses.altitude: The analyst sets standards, tests and review for the model rather than hand-editing every measure.
reach: Controller: shared cost-centre and FTE definitions with Finance
FP&A Analyst: reuse of the HR model in budget work

tasks.human_edge: Deciding how a metric should be defined at Noordhaven and agreeing it with Finance and HR.
tasks.pattern_why: Changes need judgement on definitions; AI speeds drafting and testing but the analyst leads.

in_practice.trigger: Refresh failure, AFAS change notice or change request.
steps: Copilot drafts DAX or Power Query change from the request
Run regression tests on key measures
Analyst reviews and publishes
AI updates the measure documentation
in_practice.human_gate: Analyst approves every change before publishing.
in_practice.logs_to: Change log in SharePoint or Git repository of the model

evidence.claim: Copilot in Power BI writes DAX
Automated regression tests on measures cut testing time

risks: Plausible but wrong DAX passes review
Undocumented AFAS changes still break the extract
research_questions: How many model changes and refresh failures happen per month?
Can the model be put under version control (PBIP format) here?

tasks.short: Help managers and HR colleagues when a dashboard is wrong, slow or confusing.

today.trigger: Teams or mail message: 'the number is wrong', 'I can't see my team', 'how do I filter'.
steps: Reproduce the issue
Check access, filters and data freshness
Fix or explain
Reply to the user
drudgery: Explaining the same filters and definitions
today.time_sinks: Reproducing issues under someone else's access and tracing a figure back to AFAS.

lenses.faster: An assistant checks refresh status, access and definitions first and answers how-to questions from documentation.
lenses.autonomous: Known issues (stale data, missing access) are detected and explained to the user without the analyst.
lenses.ambitious: Short in-dashboard explanations for every page, in Dutch, so most questions never arise.
lenses.joy: The analyst fixes real data problems instead of repeating filter instructions.
lenses.options: Offer the user two or three likely causes with how to check each.
lenses.altitude: The analyst improves documentation and checks from the support log rather than answering each ticket.
reach: HR Administrator: first-line support for AFAS self-service questions

tasks.human_edge: Spotting that a 'wrong number' is actually a data entry problem or a sensitive case.
tasks.pattern_why: Triage uses tools (refresh logs, access lists, docs); fixes to data or access need the analyst.

in_practice.trigger: Support message in a Teams channel.
steps: Agent checks refresh status and the user's access
Answers how-to and definition questions from documentation
Drafts a diagnosis for data issues
Analyst approves fix or reply
in_practice.human_gate: Analyst approves any access change or data correction.

evidence.claim: Copilot in Power BI answers questions on a prepared semantic model
Triage of support tickets by an LLM agent

risks: Agent grants or suggests access it should not
Users lose trust after a wrong explanation
research_questions: What share of support requests are how-to, access or data errors?
Is dashboard documentation complete enough to answer from?

tasks.short: Track which managers and sites use HR dashboards and how the staffing agencies perform on orders and hours.

today.trigger: Quarterly agency review, low dashboard use noticed, peak-season flex planning.
steps: Pull Power BI usage metrics
Export agency fill rates, hours and invoices from three portals
Compare agencies on fill rate, no-shows and cost
Share findings with HR Director and site managers
drudgery: Merging three agency formats by hand
today.time_sinks: Normalising agency data before any comparison.

lenses.faster: Agency data loads into one standard table; a scorecard per agency and a usage report per site update weekly.
lenses.autonomous: Fill rate below target or invoice hours above recorded hours trigger an alert to the site manager and HR.
lenses.ambitious: A proper agency scorecard tied to 90-day retention of flex workers converted to permanent staff.
lenses.joy: No more manual merging; time goes to the conversation with agencies.
lenses.options: Scenario views for peak season: which agency mix covers the expected 300 flex workers.
lenses.altitude: The analyst designs the scorecard and thresholds; the pipeline runs it.
reach: Bookkeeper: matching agency invoices to hours
Recruiter: input for agency contract talks

tasks.human_edge: Interpreting why an agency underperforms and handling the relationship conversation.
tasks.pattern_why: Structured data, fixed metrics and thresholds; checkable output.

in_practice.trigger: Weekly schedule and new agency invoice received.
steps: Import agency orders, hours and invoices
Match to AFAS cost centres and site rosters
Compute fill rate, no-show and cost per hour
Alert on threshold breaches
in_practice.human_gate: Analyst reviews alerts before they go to agencies or Finance.
in_practice.logs_to: Power BI dataset and alert log

evidence.claim: Rule-based scorecards from structured supplier data

risks: Dashboard usage per manager is itself monitoring of behaviour and may need OR consent
Agency portal data is incomplete or late
research_questions: Do the three agencies share order and fill data in a usable format?
Would Finance use the hours-to-invoice match for payment checks?

tasks.short: Build new dashboards, data tables or Excel tools when HR wants to track something new.

today.trigger: New request from HR Director, HRBP or OR, e.g. onboarding completion in week one.
steps: Clarify the question and metric definition
Find and model the source data
Build the dashboard
Test with users and publish
today.time_sinks: Agreeing definitions and getting usable source data out of Studytube and Recruitee.

lenses.faster: AI drafts the spec, data model, measures and a first layout from the request; the analyst refines.
lenses.autonomous: Not autonomous; new tools need definitions and, with personal data, OR consent.
lenses.ambitious: A full hire-to-productive view joining Recruitee, AFAS and Studytube certificates (forklift, VCA) per hire up to day 90.
lenses.joy: Faster prototypes so users react to something real early.
lenses.options: Three mock-up layouts and two metric definitions to choose from with the requester.
lenses.altitude: The analyst runs a small intake and design process rather than building each tool by hand.
reach: L&D Specialist: certificate compliance dashboards
Recruiter: pipeline dashboards

tasks.human_edge: Choosing what to measure and testing whether a tool would observe individual behaviour.
tasks.pattern_why: Design choices and definitions stay with the analyst; AI speeds drafting.

in_practice.trigger: Approved request in the HR analytics intake list.
steps: AI drafts spec and data model
Analyst checks definitions and privacy (DPIA, OR need)
AI generates measures and prototype
Analyst tests with users and publishes
in_practice.human_gate: Analyst and HR Director sign off; OR consent where personal data or behaviour is observable.
in_practice.logs_to: Intake list and design notes in SharePoint

evidence.claim: Text-to-SQL cut query time from about 10 to 3 minutes; hallucinated tables remain
Copilot in Power BI writes DAX and builds report pages
Works council consent for facilities able to observe performance

risks: Fast build skips the OR consent step
research_questions: Can Studytube and Recruitee be joined to AFAS on a reliable employee key?
How long does OR consent take for a new HR dashboard here?

tasks.short: Keep AFAS personnel data clean and compile hires, transfers, appraisals and verzuim statistics.

today.trigger: Monthly close, verzuim reports for the OR and arbodienst, annual reports.
steps: Check AFAS for missing end dates, open sick reports, wrong cost centres
Ask HR Administrators to correct
Compile rates for hires, transfers, appraisals and verzuim
Publish statistics to HR, MT and OR
drudgery: Hunting the same data errors each month
Recomputing verzuim frequency and percentage by hand
today.time_sinks: Chasing corrections before the figures can be trusted.

lenses.faster: Nightly rule checks flag errors to HR Administrators with an explanation; statistics compute in the model.
lenses.autonomous: Data-quality checks run daily so 90-day retention and verzuim are correct by day 2 of the month.
lenses.ambitious: Verified daily verzuim and retention figures per site, rates and durations only, never causes.
lenses.joy: No more chasing; the analyst sees a clean queue.
lenses.options: Show verzuim by short, medium and long duration and by site to support poortwachter planning.
lenses.altitude: The analyst maintains the rule set and metric definitions.
reach: HR Administrator: correction queue with clear instructions
Payroll Specialist: contract-end checks before payroll

tasks.human_edge: Deciding how to treat edge cases and protecting health data.
tasks.pattern_why: Data rules and statistical formulas can be written down and checked.

steps: Run rule checks (missing end dates, open sick reports beyond limits, cost-centre mismatches)
LLM writes a plain explanation per issue
Route issues to HR Administrators
Compute statistics after corrections
in_practice.human_gate: HR Administrator corrects in AFAS; analyst signs off monthly figures.
data_needed: AFAS employee, contract, absence tables (no diagnosis fields)

evidence.claim: Absence data is health data; AP fined a firm partly for recording sick-leave cause
Rule-based checks on missing end dates and open sick reports

risks: Recording or deriving cause of absence breaches AVG
research_questions: Which ten AFAS errors cause most rework today?
Does the OR verzuim report need anything beyond rates and durations?

tasks.short: Scan labour market, CAO and regional trends around Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo for HR strategy.

today.trigger: Strategy session, CAO negotiations, hiring problems in a region.
steps: Read CBS, UWV and sector sources and news
Pull internal turnover and hiring data
Compare regions
Write a short memo for the HR Director
drudgery: Reading long reports for two numbers

lenses.faster: An LLM summarises sources with citations and caveats and joins public data to internal figures.
lenses.autonomous: A monthly scan of CBS, UWV and CAO news produces a cited digest for review.
lenses.ambitious: Quarterly regional labour outlooks per site linked to time to hire and offer acceptance.
lenses.joy: Less reading, more thinking about what it means for Noordhaven.
lenses.options: Scenarios for peak-season flex supply per region.
lenses.altitude: The analyst sets the sources and checks the digest.
reach: FP&A Analyst: wage cost scenarios
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: market pay context

tasks.human_edge: Judging relevance and keeping caveats; contacts with sector peers stay human.
tasks.pattern_why: Unstructured sources to structured, cited summaries inside a scheduled workflow.

steps: Collect listed sources
LLM summarises with citations and caveats
Join with internal metrics
Analyst reviews and sends
in_practice.human_gate: Analyst checks every claim and source before sending.

evidence.claim: Trend reports often cannot establish causation; caveats must stay
LLM summarisation of sources with citations

research_questions: Which decisions used trend memos in the last year?
Are CBS and UWV regional series fine-grained enough per site?

role.altitude: From producing reports to owning Noordhaven's HR metric layer: definitions, verified answers, access rules, data checks and the pipelines managers and agents query.
reach: HR Administrator: AFAS data-quality queue
HR Business Partner: first-line manager data questions
FP&A Analyst: flex labour and FTE cost views
L&D Specialist: certificate compliance reporting
Recruiter: pipeline and agency scorecards
role.ceiling_note: Limited by AFAS extract quality, Power BI capacity (Copilot needs Fabric F2+ or Premium), works council consent for tools that can observe behaviour, AVG limits on health data, and Annex III high-risk rules from Dec 2027 for performance evaluation.
skills_to_grow: Semantic model design and verified answers in Power BI
Privacy and works council procedure (DPIA, WOR 27)
role.ambitious_version: Every manager gets correct North Star inputs (time to hire, 90-day retention, verzuim) for their team by day 2 of the month and can ask questions in Teams, while the analyst spends most time on hire-to-productive analysis and on site-level retention forecasts agreed with the OR.
